name: c3bot-relay
description: c3bot-relay (#1579): Telegram <-> c3 relay on the c3-bot (Bot A, ONE token). Primary ingestion is webhook mode via the public c3-pub route /c3bot-webhook (secret_token checked). While the webhook is unhealthy the relay calls deleteWebhook and polls Bot A with getUpdates, then setWebhook again when the route recovers (never both at once, so no 409). Deduped by chat+message_id+date. Inbound events fan out over WebSocket (/ws), SSE (/events, Last-Event-ID resume) and long-poll (/poll, cursor). Outbound via POST /send or a WS send frame, sent as Bot A. Zero npm dependencies. API bearer-gated, mesh-only; only the webhook path is public.

primary._auth_doc: auth none: the app gates every call itself with its own bearer (C3BOT_RELAY_TOKEN, 401 without it; /health is open). The fleet forward_auth would reject this token and buffer SSE; the route stays WG-only. streaming:true keeps SSE and WebSocket unbuffered.

api.description: Telegram <-> c3 relay: WS /ws, SSE /events, long-poll /poll, POST /send.

secrets._doc: Values only in the private vault at Linux-Containers/infra-ops_c3bot-relay/src/ (sops, public fleet recipient; the Ship overlay copies secrets.yaml and its secrets.*.yaml fragments in, the engine merges them and mounts .secrets as env_file). Three keys by NAME. C3BOT_RELAY_TOKEN: 64-hex bearer of the relay API (CI sops-create generates it; cloud-infra-mcp reads the same value through a consumer fragment); the server exits 78 when empty. C3BOT_WEBHOOK_SECRET: 64-hex Telegram secret_token of the Bot A webhook (CI sops-create, secrets.webhook.yaml); the webhook route answers 503 without it and 401 on a wrong header. C3BOT_A_BOT_TOKEN: the token of the existing c3-bot (Bot A, the same token cloud-infra-mcp holds as C3_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN), copied by the CI sops-copy workflow into secrets.bot-a.yaml; used for setWebhook/deleteWebhook/getWebhookInfo/getUpdates and outbound sendMessage. There is no second bot (architect decision, #1579): the fallback is the same token switching mode, so only one consumer ever reads Bot A. Without C3BOT_A_BOT_TOKEN the relay starts degraded (ingest.mode degraded, /send 503).
